# Registration

Registration is free but required, as capacity is limited. To help us manage attendance, registrations will be confirmed by email. If you later find that you cannot attend, we would greatly appreciate advanced notice so that we can offer your place to someone on the waitlist.

Registration will **close** on **Friday, May 29**.
